How Cloudflare's challenge platform works

Open the source of a "Just a moment..." page and the first inline script is the configuration object:

(function(){window._cf_chl_opt = {cFPWv: 'b', cType: 'managed'};
var a = document.createElement('script');
a.src = '/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/h/b/orchestrate/chl_page/v1?ray=0';
document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(a);}());

The orchestrate script at /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/h/b/orchestrate/chl_page/v1 then runs the managed challenge.
